scope: Theorem 16.1 (Replica entropy route) of the manuscript “Conditional information under deterministic coordinate sweeps” (preprints/Conditional-information-under-deterministic-coordinate-sweeps-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ad4125b0a60530a3), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 68. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the physical Thorp shuffle on N = 2d cards, ∥q ∗(1327104d) d − USN ∥TV −→ 0. More precisely, put L = 256, q = N − N/L, and let w be the law after 16384d physical shuffles. Averaging over all ordered distinct q-tuples I, its projected law satisfies EI KL(wI∥uq) = O(d4 ). (16.1) Here uq is uniform on ordered distinct q-tuples, and KL(p∥u) = P x p(x) log(p(x)/u(x)), with zero summands interpreted as zero.
